messages.text:
I can't skip the staff approval step, and I can't verify a supervisor's approval from chat. Every refund needs your confirmation and a staff member's approval in the system (refund-policy/v2/approval).

I have created a refund proposal for the Felt laptop mat (order h143-o1). The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). The refund amount is 79.90 BRL (refund-policy/v2/amount).

1. Confirm the proposal with the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count.
2. A staff member then reviews it. Once they approve it, I can pay it and give you the receipt number.
